questions.question: Which landlocked South American country is bordered by Brazil, Argentina, and Bolivia?
questions.fun_fact: Paraguay is one of only two landlocked countries in South America, the other being Bolivia.

questions.question: What is the powerhouse of the eukaryotic cell, responsible for generating most of the chemical energy needed?
questions.fun_fact: Mitochondria contain their own independent DNA that is typically inherited exclusively from the mother.

questions.question: Who was the first female Prime Minister of the United Kingdom?
questions.fun_fact: Margaret Thatcher served as the Prime Minister of the United Kingdom from 1979 to 1990, earning the nickname 'The Iron Lady'.

questions.question: Which 1994 animated Disney film features the song 'Circle of Life' and follows the journey of a young lion named Simba?
questions.fun_fact: The Lion King was originally developed under the working title 'King of the Jungle'.

questions.question: Pesto sauce traditionally originates from which Italian region?
questions.fun_fact: Traditional Genovese pesto is made using crushed garlic, basil, European pine nuts, coarse salt, Parmigiano-Reggiano, and pecorino cheese blended with olive oil.

questions.question: What is the primary diet of a giant panda?
questions.fun_fact: Bamboo accounts for up to 99 percent of a giant panda's diet, and they must spend up to 12 hours a day eating it to meet their energy needs.

questions.question: In the modern Olympic Games, how many points are awarded for scoring a gold medal in terms of overall country standings?
options: Medal counts are ranked by gold medals first, regardless of total counts
questions.fun_fact: The International Olympic Committee does not officially recognize a global ranking system for countries, but media outlets traditionally sort by the number of gold medals won.

questions.question: What is the term for a figure of speech that makes an implicit, implied, or hidden comparison between two unrelated things, such as 'Time is a thief'?
questions.fun_fact: Unlike similes, metaphors do not use comparative words such as 'like' or 'as'.

questions.question: Which planet in our solar system has the most prominent and complex system of planetary rings made mostly of ice particles?
questions.fun_fact: Saturn's rings are extremely wide—spanning hundreds of thousands of kilometers—yet they are remarkably thin, typically only about 10 meters thick in most places.

questions.question: Which African nation has the highest population as of recent demographic records?
questions.fun_fact: Nigeria is not only the most populous country in Africa, but it is also projected to be one of the top population centers globally in the coming decades.
